scenario.initial_request: Build an AI assistant that drafts apology replies to customers who complain about being charged twice

CL-01.statement: Build an AI assistant that drafts apology replies to customers who complain about being charged twice

CL-02.statement: On 09-09 we switched idempotency-key enforcement off on the gateway to debug capture latency. It was meant to be temporary. Gateway timeouts and automatic capture retries have always happened at about the same rate; with the key the PSP drops the retried capture. Turning enforcement back on is a one-setting change through the gateway config tool, but payments operations has to confirm it at runtime.

CL-03.statement: Customers are furious about double charges. We just need faster, nicer apology replies.

H-DUPLICATE-CHARGES.statement: Customers are being charged twice for a single order due to duplicate capture attempts.

H-IDEMPOTENCY-KEY-DISABLED.statement: Payment gateway capture idempotency key enforcement is disabled, allowing retries to create duplicate captures.

H-PSP-DUPLICATE-ATTEMPTS.statement: Payment service provider logs show duplicate capture attempts for the same order due to PSP-side retry logic.

interpretation_history.interpretation: The weekly tally of support tickets about double charges rose sharply in weeks 2026-W37 and 2026-W38, with 288 and 301 tickets respectively out of ~21k orders each week. This indicates a recent increase in double-charge complaints.
The observation shows duplicate captures (orders_with_2_captures) appear only on days with gateway timeout retries, indicating that duplicate charges occur when retries happen.

On 2026-09-09 payments engineer SH-PAY disabled the gateway's idempotency key enforcement for capture retries (noted as temporary for latency debugging). This change allowed duplicate captures on days with gateway timeout retries, consistent with the observed duplicate charges on 2026-09-09 and 2026-09-10.

The PSP log shows that duplicate capture attempts occurred only as gateway timeout retries without idempotency keys during 2026-09-09..10, while earlier periods had no duplicates because retries were deduplicated and idempotency keys were sent.

E-05.content: On 09-09 we switched idempotency-key enforcement off on the gateway to debug capture latency. It was meant to be temporary. Gateway timeouts and automatic capture retries have always happened at about the same rate; with the key the PSP drops the retried capture. Turning enforcement back on is a one-setting change through the gateway config tool, but payments operations has to confirm it at runtime.

interpretation_history.interpretation: The stakeholder confirms that idempotency key enforcement was turned off on 2026-09-09 for latency debugging, which allowed gateway timeout retries to create duplicate captures.

E-06.content: Customers are furious about double charges. We just need faster, nicer apology replies.

interpretation_history.interpretation: The stakeholder confirms that double-charge complaints are causing customer anger and that faster, nicer apology replies are desired, but does not address the underlying cause of the duplicate charges.

symptoms: Increase in support tickets about double charges (weeks 2026-W37 and 2026-W38)
causal_chain: Idempotency key enforcement on the payment gateway is disabled (E-03).
Gateway experiences timeout retries at a roughly constant rate (E-02, E-05).
Retries are sent without an idempotency key (E-04).
The PSP processes the retry as a new capture because no deduplication key is present (E-04).
The order ends up with two captures, producing a duplicate charge visible to the customer (E-01, E-02).

proposal.root_problem: Disabled idempotency key enforcement on the payment gateway allows gateway timeout retries to produce duplicate captures, resulting in customers being charged twice for a single order.
proposal.requested_solution: Build an AI assistant that drafts apology replies to customers who complain about being charged twice
causal_chain: Gateway timeout triggers automatic capture retry
Retry sent without idempotency key (due to disabled enforcement)
PSP processes retry as a new capture (no deduplication)
Order receives two captures → duplicate charge
Customer observes double charge and files support ticket (E-01)
